We ﬁrst aim to determine whether

The improvement of REALM over ORQA is purely due
to better pre-training. The results also indicate that our
method of pre-training can be applied both on (1) the single-
corpus setting (X = Wikipedia, Z = Wikipedia), or (2) the
separate-corpus setting (X = CC-News, Z = Wikipedia).
Compared to other retrieval-based systems (Asai et al., 2019;
Min et al., 2019a;b) which often retrieve from 20 to 80
documents, our system gets the overall best performance
while only retrieving 5 documents.
